title: Counterfactual Certification for Sequential Unlearning with Long-Run Performance Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2610.17993v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Certified machine unlearning ensures the proximity between the unlearned model and a model retrained without the data to be forgotten. Extending this framework to sequential deletion requests, typically arriving as groups of variable size (e.g., all records of one user or of coordinated users), is challenging. For unlearning methods based on fine-tuning on the retain sets, this leads to either degrading performance or increasing computation as the number of unlearning requests grows. For independent successive requests, we instead certify each model release against a counterfactual unlearning trajectory in which the group being deleted never took part. With a fixed fine-tuning budget per deletion, we show that, for smooth strongly convex objectives, this approach keeps the performance loss bounded, uniformly in the number of requests. translated_title: 具有长期性能保证的序列式机器遗忘的反事实认证
translated_abstract: 认证机器遗忘旨在确保未学习模型与在不含待遗忘数据的保留集上重新训练所得模型之间的接近性。将该框架扩展到按顺序到达的删除请求具有挑战性，这些请求通常以大小可变的组的形式出现（例如某一用户或一组协同用户的全部记录）。对于基于在保留集上进行微调的遗忘方法，随着遗忘请求数量的增长，这会导致性能下降或计算量增加。针对独立的连续请求，我们转而针对一种反事实遗忘轨迹来对每次模型发布进行认证——在该轨迹中，被删除的组从未参与过训练。在每次删除使用固定微调预算的条件下，我们证明：对于光滑的强凸目标函数，该方法能够使性能损失保持有界，且该界与请求总数无关（一致有界）。在FEMNIST数据集上对多类逻辑回归的实验表明，所得到的算法只需很少
tldr: 该论文提出一种针对序列式机器遗忘请求的反事实认证方法，在每次删除仅使用固定微调预算的情况下，对于光滑强凸目标函数可将性能损失约束在与请求次数无关的有界范围内。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a counterfactual certification framework for sequential machine unlearning that, with a fixed fine-tuning budget per deletion, keeps the performance loss bounded uniformly in the number of requests for smooth strongly convex objectives.
